stages.name: Demand
stages.job: Create enough qualified attention from the right kind of buyer

stages.name: Sales Process
stages.job: Turn attention into qualified opportunities that progress

stages.name: Closing
stages.job: Convert late-stage opportunities into signed business with predictable timing

stages.name: Expand
stages.job: Turn signed customers into renewals, adoption and expansion

root_causes.name: Product
root_causes.asks: Is the proposition, value and business case sharp enough?

root_causes.name: People
root_causes.asks: Are the right people, with the right judgement and accountability, owning it?

root_causes.name: Process
root_causes.asks: Is there a defined, evidenced way of working that can be inspected?

root_causes.name: Repeatability
root_causes.asks: Is what works captured, codified and reused rather than reinvented?

arithmetic: stage = mean(the 4 cells in that row)
rootCause = mean(that cause across all 4 stages)
